purpose: Non-authoritative observation of an application's deployed release identity for comparison with canonical Shine Defence certification state.
rules: Observations record what an identified source reported as deployed; they do not certify that release.
releaseCommitSha and profileBlobSha are exact lowercase 40-character Git SHA-1 identities.
observedAt is an explicit UTC timestamp and observations are append-only historical facts.
source and reference are bounded non-secret provenance fields.
The latest observation per app is selected deterministically by observedAt then observationId.
Observation evaluation reuses release-status-v1 with the app's exact certification receipt, immutable receipt registry snapshot and current revocation ledger.
A reviewed_release result maps to protected.
An unreviewed_revision result maps to deployment_drift.
A profile_drift result maps to profile_drift.
A revoked_release result maps to revoked.
receipt_missing or verification_failed maps to needs_review.
No deployment observation changes candidate, checklist, receipt, reviewed-ledger, decision or revocation state.
nonClaims: An observation does not prove that every running instance uses the observed release.
deployment_drift and profile_drift do not by themselves mean the release is unsafe.
needs_review is a workflow state, not a security verdict.
Only protected may be treated as an observed deployment matching the current Defence proof.
